subject: Fix fd check in memtest_test_linux_anonymous_maps (#12943)
reason: The change fixes an error-path fd check (-1 vs 0) in memtest_test_linux_anonymous_maps, which runs only inside the crash report handler (doFastMemoryTest after SIGSEGV/SIGBUS) and only when open() on the logfile fails at crash time. No command, replication, persistence or tool path reaches it on a live server; exercising it would require deliberately crashing an instance (which the fuzzer's liveness oracle treats as a failure and whose crash-triggering DEBUG commands are refused) while also making the logfile unopenable, which no installed fault can do.
